_note: Governing-documents register (statuten, reglement van orde, splitsingsakte) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Index + detail pages for the governing-document register; schema refs BY SLUG (governing-document), never the PascalCase key GoverningDocument (multi-word schema — the exact silent-breakage case). The version timeline with the 'geldend op' (in-force-on-date) control (REQ-GDR-004/006) and the citing-decisions reverse lookup (REQ-GDR-005) are wired imperatively by the page/service tasks; this declarative fragment provides the page skeleton, quick filters on type/status, the data + files (consolidated text) + related widgets, and mass export.

config._note: Governing-documents list (REQ-GDR-006). Columns citeertitel/type/governingBody/status; quick filters on type and status; full-text search over citeertitel. The current-version inwerkingtreding column and the per-document in-force resolution come from the consolidation service (no per-row N+1 — resolved as a pure OR list query by the page task). CSV export via the shared ExportService + CnMassExportDialog (mass-export exposed by the index chrome).

GoverningDocumentDetail (REQ-GDR-003/004/005/006). Document metadata leads 8-wide; the linked governingBody renders as a resolved reference in the data + Related widgets. The Related widget surfaces the full version timeline (each GoverningDocumentVersie with versienummer, inwerkingtreding, state, its enacting-decision link where present — navigating to the existing Decision detail page — and notarial-deed metadata where present), the 'geldend op' date control driving the REQ-GDR-004 resolution, and the reverse lookup of decisions citing this document via citesGoverningDocuments (REQ-GDR-005) — all wired imperatively by the page/service tasks; keyboard-navigable, WCAG 2.1 AA. Files leaf for the consolidated-text PDF per sealed version (OR file abstraction). Audit trail is a sidebar tab.
